title: Ex-Central Bank Governor György Matolcsy Detained in Fraud Probe
detail: Police detained György Matolcsy, governor of the Hungarian National Bank from 2013 to 2025, on suspicion of economic fraud causing significant financial loss and use of a forged private document, according to his lawyer. The case stems from a September complaint after a central bank audit of real-estate purchases at inflated prices and is linked to the bank's foundations (PADME). Telex reported it is the first time a former central bank governor has been taken into custody in Hungary. Matolcsy has previously denied wrongdoing.

media.caption: Former Hungarian central bank chief Matolcsy detained in financial fraud probe
